name: Gitea
description: Self-hosted Git with issues and pull requests. The admin account below is created for you.

configFields.label: Secret key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Signs Gitea's tokens and locks the installer.

configFields.label: Admin password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Password for the seeded admin account.

prepare.title: Create the Gitea admin
prepare.description: Seeds the administrator account so you can sign in immediately.
prepare.command: su-exec git gitea admin user create --admin --username "$GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME" --password "$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" --email "$GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL" --must-change-password=false 2>&1 || true; echo done

readiness.test: su-exec git gitea admin user list >/dev/null 2>&1

connection.title: Sign in to Gitea
connection.description: Your admin account is created during install. New self-registration is disabled — invite users from Site Administration.

outputs.label: Gitea
outputs.help: Sign in with the username and password below.

firstLogin.note: INSTALL_LOCK is on, so the public setup wizard is disabled and cannot be used to hijack the instance. The password above works as-is.
